What We Do

Our Services

Seal Coating

Protective sealant that extends pavement life and sharpens curb appeal.

Crack Fill

Stops water intrusion before it turns small cracks into potholes.

Striping

Parking stalls, fire lanes, ADA markings, and traffic lines laid clean and true.

Grading

Correcting drainage and surface pitch before any coating goes down.

Patching

Full-depth and surface patching for potholes and failed sections.

Pressure Washing

Lots, driveways, and structures cleaned ahead of coating or on their own.

Fence Painting

Perimeter and property fencing refreshed alongside your lot work.

Trucking

Material hauling and delivery to keep your job moving on schedule.

About Emerald

Built on the trade, not around it

Emerald Seal Coating and Striping Services is a family-owned contractor built on hands-on experience in the paving trade. We treat every lot and driveway like it's the one out front of our own shop.

Every estimate is free, every job is measured before it's quoted, and every stripe goes down straight — because a parking lot is the first thing your customers see.
